title: Chess Board
subtitle: A free board for explaining moves and positions. No rules, no turns.

palette.title: Pieces
palette.hint: Drag a piece onto the board, or click a piece and then a square. Drag a piece off the board to remove it.

play.title: Play against the computer
play.description: Set up any position on the board, pick your side, and the computer plays it out with you. You move first.

errors.invalid: This position isn't valid. Each side needs exactly one king, and pawns can't be on the first or last rank.
errors.check: This position is illegal: the side that isn't to move is in check.
errors.over: This position is already checkmate or a draw.
